h1: Fes Festival of World Sacred Music

overview.about: The Fes Festival of World Sacred Music is a renowned gathering in the ancient Moroccan city of Fez, bringing together sacred and spiritual music traditions from across the world's faiths. Set against the backdrop of the medieval medina, it is a celebration of music as a bridge between cultures.
overview.nextEvent: The next Fes Festival of World Sacred Music is held in June in Fez, with concerts in historic palaces, gardens and public squares. Artists from many religious and musical traditions perform across the week.

@graph.description: The Fes Festival of World Sacred Music gathers devotional music of many faiths in Morocco's ancient city of Fez each June, staged in palaces, gardens and medina squares. It was founded in 1994 as a response to cultural division.
